openApi.evidence: dialog.matches(':modal') === true while open; the dialog carries autofocus and data-modal-transition-base='{"opacity":0,"transform":"none"}'

openTimeline_390_ms.71: dialog gets style display:flex then visibility:hidden then both cleared; open attribute added (showModal); .modal-container inline style 'opacity:0;transform:none'; .modal-backdrop inline style 'opacity:0'
openTimeline_390_ms.77: the 5 [data-toggle-content] keep inert + aria-hidden=true (all accordions start closed)
openTimeline_390_ms.86: appear runtime writes an inline `transition:<dur> <easing> <delay>, --g-angle, --g-color-0,...` on each target then swaps class appear -> appear-active for batch 1: sd-1, sd-5, sd-6, sd-7, sd-8, sd-75, sd-123, sd-141, sd-229, sd-264, sd-285, sd-287, sd-288, sd-289
openTimeline_390_ms.88: appear-active removed from batch 1 (present ~2 ms / 1 frame)
openTimeline_390_ms.477: sd-143 appear-active removed; .modal-container and .modal-backdrop inline styles removed

openBatchExplanation: The batches are IntersectionObserver callbacks, not timers: sd-3 sits inside sd-1 (translate -160px) and sd-10/77/125/143/231/266 sit inside sd-8/75/123/141/229/264 (translate -160px), so they only start intersecting once their ancestor has slid in. A clone that removes `appear` from every node at once will NOT reproduce the cascade.

closeTimeline_ms.0: click .modal-ja_menu__sd-5 (onclick=hideCurrentModal(this)) OR Escape (native cancel is intercepted by the same runtime)
closeTimeline_ms.10-46: dialog class modal-ready -> modal-closing; .modal-container inline style 'opacity:0;transform:none'; .modal-backdrop inline style 'opacity:0' (0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0.4,0,1))
closeTimeline_ms.443-491: dialog.close(): open attribute removed, class back to 'modal-ja_menu', the class `appear` is re-added to all 29 targets, all 5 toggles reset to aria-expanded=false + inert + aria-hidden=true
closeTimeline_ms.note: measured 443 ms via Escape and 491 ms via the close button; the fade itself is 400 ms

focus.trap: native showModal top-layer trap; no JS focus trap of its own

escape.path: same modal-closing fade as the close button

scrollLock.evidence: while open, window.scrollTo(0,300) left scrollY unchanged at 12672.5
scrollLock.mechanism: native modal dialog top layer — body/html computed overflow stay 'visible', no class or inline style is added to <html> or <body>

backdrop.element: div.modal-backdrop.modal-ja_menu__backdrop (first child of the dialog, position:absolute, inset 0)
backdrop.note: fully transparent — the opaque panel .modal-ja_menu__sd-7 (#222222, height 100vh, width 100%) is what covers the page. The UA ::backdrop is also transparent (`.sd-root dialog::backdrop{background:transparent}` in app/studio-base.css).

accordions.evidence: opening sd-75 while sd-8 was open: sd-8 lost `open` and got data-toggle-closing at +1 ms, height 799.95 -> 0
accordions.closingEvidence: data-toggle-closing added t=1503, removed together with `open` at t=2309
accordions.closeOutside: clicking empty dialog chrome (195,60) closed the open panel and left the dialog open
accordions.icon: plus/minus built from two 15x1.5 #EEEEEE bars: .sd-12 static horizontal, .sd-13 position:absolute left0 top0. Closed: .sd-13 opacity 1 rotate 90deg (0.8s). Open: .sd-13 opacity 0 rotate 0deg.

attrStates.closed: sd-toggle has no [open]; button aria-expanded=false; content inert + aria-hidden=true; content height 0px
attrStates.open: sd-toggle[open]; aria-expanded=true; inert and aria-hidden removed; content height auto
attrStates.closing: sd-toggle keeps [open] and gains [data-toggle-closing] for 800 ms

appearActive.measured: the runtime writes the inline shorthand `transition: 0.8s cubic-bezier(0, 1, 1, 1), --g-angle, ...` on sd-7 in the same tick it adds appear-active, and an inline declaration outranks the class rule, so cubic-bezier(0,1,1,1) is what actually runs; appear-active is present for ~2 ms.
